name: Unreal II: The Awakening
description: Unreal II: The Awakening is a singleplayer first-person shooter game and the second in the Unreal series.

steam.store_details: Delisted in December 2022, when Epic pulled the entire classic Unreal series from sale.

gog.store_details: Delisted in December 2022, when Epic pulled the entire classic Unreal series from sale.

audio_settings.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_settings.reason: Unreal II ships with EAX and 3D sound off and loads its bundled DefOpenAL32.dll instead of the OpenAL32.dll this script installs. In the game's options, only the EAX part is shown, as 'EAX 3.0 (Audigy only)'.
